from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, math, os, platform, statistics, subprocess, sys
root = Path('/home/phulin/umber4-producer')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root/'benchmarks'))
import mvp, producer

folder = root/'target/producer-operands'
cpu = min(os.sched_getaffinity(0)); os.sched_setaffinity(0, {cpu})
command, env = reference(None, folder/'pdftex')
engines = {'umber': ([str(folder/'final')], None), 'pdftex': (command, env),
           'baseline': ([str(folder/'baseline')], None),
           'previous': ([str(folder/'previous')], None),
           'original': ([str(root/'target/producer-bench/baseline')], None)}
metadata = {'date': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'pdftex': subprocess.check_output([command[0], '--version'], env=env).decode().splitlines()[0],
    'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '--version']).decode().strip(),
    'rustflags': os.environ.get('RUSTFLAGS', ''), 'machine': platform.platform(),
    'cpu': cpu, 'cpu_model': next(line.split(':',1)[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('model name')),
    'commits': {k: subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',ref],cwd=root).decode().strip() for k,ref in [('baseline','8b7f789'),('previous','6a6ca50'),('original','29266eb')]},
    'binaries': {k: hashlib.sha256(Path(args[0]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k,(args,_) in engines.items()},
    'measurement_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(mvp.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'driver_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'repeats': 9}
for label,module,cases,size in [
    ('core', mvp, ['raw','bodies','integers','groups','source-integers'], 2000000),
    ('focused', producer, ['handoff','tail-loop','nested-bodies'], 1000000),
    ('conversions', producer, ['conversions'], 500000),
    ('definitions', producer, ['definitions'], 100000),
    ('messages', producer, ['messages'], 100000)]:
    report = {**metadata, 'generator_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'complete': False, 'samples': []}
    startup = folder/f'{label}-startup.tex'; startup.write_text(mvp.BOOT+r'\message{UMBER:0,0:END}\end'+'\n')
    report['startup'] = mvp.measure(engines, startup, b'0,0', 9)
    for case in cases:
        source,expected = module.program(case,size)
        path = folder/f'{case}-{size}.tex'; path.write_bytes(source)
        sample = {'case': case, 'size': size, 'bytes': len(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(), **mvp.measure(engines,path,expected,9)}
        for name in ['previous','original']:
            sample['cpu_ratio_to_'+name] = sample['cpu_median']['umber']/sample['cpu_median'][name]
        report['samples'].append(sample)
        (folder/f'{label}-confirm.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(f"{case:16} CPU {sample['cpu_median']['umber']:.6f} baseline {sample['cpu_ratio_to_baseline']:.3f} previous {sample['cpu_ratio_to_previous']:.3f} original {sample['cpu_ratio_to_original']:.3f} pdftex {sample['cpu_ratio']:.3f}",flush=True)
    report['complete'] = True
    for name,key in [('baseline','cpu_ratio_to_baseline'),('previous','cpu_ratio_to_previous'),('original','cpu_ratio_to_original'),('pdftex','cpu_ratio')]:
        report['geomean_'+name] = math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(row[key]) for row in report['samples']))
    (folder/f'{label}-confirm.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

import argparse, hashlib, json, math, os, re, resource, statistics, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/phulin/umber4-producer')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'benchmarks'))
import mvp, producer
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('--repeats', type=int, default=3)
parser.add_argument('--cases', nargs='+')
parser.add_argument('--size', type=int)
args = parser.parse_args()
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
folder = root / 'target/producer-operands'
engines = {'baseline': folder / 'baseline',
           'previous': folder / 'previous',
           'candidate': folder / args.label}
report = {'label': args.label, 'baseline_commit': '8b7f789', 'previous_commit': '6a6ca50', 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'repeats': args.repeats, 'complete': False,
          'binaries': {k: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k,p in engines.items()},
          'samples': []}
cases = ['raw', 'bodies', 'integers', 'groups', 'source-integers', *producer.CASES]
for case in args.cases or cases:
    focused = case in producer.CASES
    size = args.size or (100000 if case in ('definitions', 'messages') else 500000 if focused else 1000000)
    source, expected = (producer if focused else mvp).program(case, size)
    path = folder / f'{case}-{size}.tex'
    path.write_bytes(source)
    samples = {k: [] for k in engines}
    for repeat in range(args.repeats + 1):
        order = list(engines)
        offset = repeat % len(order)
        order = order[offset:] + order[:offset]
        if repeat % 2 == 0:
            order.reverse()
        for k in order:
            usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
            start = usage.ru_utime + usage.ru_stime
            result = subprocess.run([str(engines[k]), str(path)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
            elapsed = usage.ru_utime + usage.ru_stime - start
            checksums = re.findall(rb'UMBER:(.*?):END', result.stdout)
            assert result.returncode == 0 and checksums == [expected], (k, case, result.stdout)
            if repeat:
                samples[k].append(elapsed)
    medians = {k: statistics.median(v) for k,v in samples.items()}
    row = {'case': case, 'size': size, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
           'cpu_seconds': samples, 'median': medians,
           'ratio_baseline': medians['candidate'] / medians['baseline'],
           'ratio_previous': medians['candidate'] / medians['previous']}
    report['samples'].append(row)
    print(f"{case:16} baseline {medians['baseline']:.6f} previous {medians['previous']:.6f} candidate {medians['candidate']:.6f} ratio {row['ratio_baseline']:.3f} prev {row['ratio_previous']:.3f}", flush=True)
    (folder / f'{args.label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
report['complete'] = True
report['geomean_baseline'] = math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['ratio_baseline']) for r in report['samples']))
report['geomean_previous'] = math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['ratio_previous']) for r in report['samples']))
(folder / f'{args.label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print('geomean baseline', report['geomean_baseline'], 'previous', report['geomean_previous'], flush=True)
